verdict.rationale: Gmail's support docs confirm snoozing, which temporarily removes an email from the inbox, so the snooze half of the story is covered. Nothing in the pack shows follow-up reminders or nudges that bring a thread back when nobody replies. Missing for 10: follow-up/no-reply reminder capability, detail on how snoozed threads resurface (scheduling options, return to inbox), independent or hands-on corroboration.
